title: Palace Adventure in Granada
text:
Mario picked us up on time, right at the bottom of the ship’s gangway, in Motril.  He was driving an immaculate Mercedes sedan to transport us to Granada.  We enjoyed pleasant conversation to and from the Palace.  The highway route views were quite nice, and we felt completely safe with Mario’s professional driving.  He went above and beyond to make sure our experience was memorable.  Definitely a 5-star transfer.

author: Geraldine_L

title: The Alhambra private guided tour
text: Our guide Sow was very knowledgeable and informative, with a great personality! Our driver Celia met us at the port in Motril very efficient and a friendly personality.  Highly recommend this tour.  Thank you Sow and Celia!
author: Brigitte_J

title: Wonderful experience at Alhambra
text: Amazing experience touring Alhambra with a professional guide named Amin. The driver picked us up from the port of Motril and we met our guide at the entrance of Alhambra. Guide was very knowledgeable and he gave us enough information without overwhelming us. A bucket list wish ticked off!
author: Sandra_H

title: Perfect day at the Alhambra!
text: Worth every penny!  Excellent private tour.  Highly recommend.  Highly knowledgeable and professional guide, great taxi driver, and great overview of the Alhambra complex.
author: lcjones

title: Very nice excursion!
text: Very nice activity! We were picked up at the cruise ship pier and then we were met by our guide at the tour location. Our driver Mario and our guide Amine were super nice and very professional. We recommend this activity!
author: Josianne_R

title: Beautiful
text:
We did a private tour with Richard. He was very knowledgeable and made our experience wonderful and informative. 

The Alhambra is vast and so beautiful.
author: Donna_S

title: Amazing!  Highly recommend!
text:
It was great!  The vehicles were beautiful, clean and comfortable.  The drivers both brought drinks and treats for us as well.

The tour guide was awesome, so knowledgeable about everything!
author: Donna_S

title: The service was...
text: The service was top-notch from both the driver Mario and the guide Fernando. I highly recommend the service for both the attention and the development of the tour.
author: Roberto_S

title: Wonderful tour with Alba and Jesus.
text: We were picked up at the Motril port by Jesus right where we walked off the ship. His car was immaculate and he brought us each a bottle of water. He's an excellent driver. He took us to Alhambra to meet up with our tour guide Alba. She really knows her history and she knotted the best picture spots. My husband just had knee surgery a few months back and she made sure that we did the least amount of steps and kept checking if we needed a break. They both made this excursion a wonderful day for us.
author: suecoutu

title: Very well worth it
text: There was a disconnect on the pickup. The message we received showed a pickup point about a mile from where the ship docked. I had to make some calls and send my location for the driver to find us. Once we connected the experience was different. Our driver Jesus was awesome. Not only did he explained things along the way from Motril to Granada, but he also was very funny. At Alhambra we met with our tour guide Pablo. He was also well mannered and since we had children with us he made an effort to keep them entertained as well. Overall the tour was excellent. I don’t know their English language
author: Manny_P
